identities.description:
The ways to sign in to the account, oldest first; empty for an account that only
lives on its devices.

public_profile.description:
The public page of the user's progress, like `/p/abcd2345ef`, made by sharing;
`null` when it's off.

recovery_code_created_at.description: When the current recovery code was made, `null` when there is none yet.

AddPlace.description: A restaurant missing from the map.

country.description:
The country whose food it serves (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), one from `/api/countries`
with a cuisine.

note.description:
`false` when the user adds it to OpenStreetMap themselves (in CoMaps or Organic Maps),
so no note asks mappers to. Defaults to `true`.

AddedPlace.description: The place just added, and what it will earn.

Addition.description: A restaurant the user added and its reward.

area_name.description: The city its bonus was judged in. `None` when no city around it was cached.

id.description:
The addition's own id, which never changes. Two additions of the same place share
a `place_id` once confirmed, but not this.

place_id.description: The pending place's id, or once confirmed its OpenStreetMap twin's.

seen.description: Whether the user was already told it is confirmed. Always `false` while pending.

xp.description: What it earns once confirmed, or earned: 0 for a duplicate.

AdditionStatus.description: Where a restaurant the user added stands.

AreaInfo.description: A place people pick as their location: a city or a postal code.

detail.description: Where it is, to tell same-named areas apart: "Vlaams-Brabant, Belgium".

id.description: Opaque and URL-safe, prefixed with the directory name, e.g. `osm-relation-196311`.

lat.description: A central point, for the map.

name.description: "Leuven", or "3000 Leuven" for a postal code.

AreaView.description: An area as clients see it.

AuthProviders.description: The sign-in methods this server offers, with the public ids the web app needs.

apple.description:
The Services ID for Sign in with Apple on the web; `null` when it isn't set up
(the iOS app signs in with Apple regardless).

google.description: The web client id for Google's sign-in button; `null` when Google isn't set up.

BadgeKind.description: What a badge rewards. Clients pick the badge's icon and colour from it.

Bonus.description: What a restaurant the user adds brings to their area, decided when they add it.

approximate.description: True for dates set by moon sighting or astronomy, which can shift by a day.

nearby.description: The celebration's countries that have places in the area.

reminder.description: Notification text for the first day, for apps that schedule reminders themselves.

oneOf.description: Where the user is right now. Optional; used to mark the visit as verified.

cuisine.description:
The OpenStreetMap `cuisine` value for its food, like "sri_lankan"; `null` when the
catalog has none. Only countries with one can be picked for a new place.

numeric.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric, zero padded. Matches the ids in the world-atlas map data.

goal.description: Places to visit for diamond: [`DIAMOND_PLACES`], or every place when there are fewer.

places.description: Places of this country in the area.

Day.description: One day of a place's week.

open.description:
When it is open, e.g. `["11:30-14:00", "18:00-22:00"]`; empty when closed all day.
A range past midnight belongs to the day it starts: "18:00-02:00".

today.description: The current day where the place is.

Device.description: A device signed in to the account.

current.description: The device this request came from.

id.description: Pass it to `DELETE /api/account/devices/{device_id}` to sign the device out.

name.description:
What the app called itself ("iPhone", "Android", "Web"), `null` for devices from
before devices had names.

ErrorBody.description: Every error response, whatever the status.

error.description: For people. It may change, so clients branch on `code` instead.

ErrorCode.description:
What went wrong, for clients that react to a specific case:

- `bad_request` (400, 413, 415, 422): invalid or missing parameters, or a malformed,
  oversized (over 2 MiB) or non-JSON body.
- `unauthorized` (401): a missing or unknown session token.
- `not_found` (404): an unknown place, area, device, code or `/api` path.
- `method_not_allowed` (405): the path exists, but not with this method.
- `nothing_open` (404): `/api/suggestion` found unvisited places, but none open now;
  ask again with `open=false`.
- `nothing_left` (404): `/api/suggestion` found no unvisited place at all.
- `too_many_requests` (429): a limit was reached, such as places added per day.
- `upstream` (502): the places or areas provider failed.
- `internal` (500): anything else, such as a database error.

Event.description: A time-limited challenge, like "Japan month". Earned badges are kept for good.

target.description: Number of different places to visit during the event.

places_nearby.description: Places in the area that count towards the event.

EventProgress.description: A time-limited challenge and how far the user got.

available.description: Countries of this group that have at least one place in the area.

discovered.description: Available countries with at least one visited place.

commit.description:
The git commit it was built from: `GIT_COMMIT` at compile time (set by the
Dockerfile), `null` in builds without it.

raw.description: OSM `opening_hours` syntax; Google hours are converted to it.

week.description:
This week, Monday to Sunday. Filled in only by `/api/places/{place_id}`. Lists, and
hours that can't be parsed, send `null`.

id_token.description: The ID token (a JWT) from Sign in with Apple or Google.

Identity.description: A way to sign in: Sign in with Apple, Google or an email address.

email.description: The address it goes with, when known. Apple may give a private relay address.

code.description: `XXXX-XXXX`, to enter on the other device. It works once.

text.description: What is happening, e.g. "Looking for restaurants".

Located.description: The areas a point lies in.

added.description: Places that weren't listed before, nearest first.

matched.description: Pending additions, anyone's, now matched to one of the places found.

device.description:
What the app calls this device in the account's device list, such as "iPhone",
"Android" or "Web". At most 60 characters are kept.

tag.description: Collapses repeated notifications of the same thing.

url.description: Where tapping the notification leads, relative to the app.

PlaceView.description: Every `Option` field is sent, as `null` when empty.

osm_url.description:
The place's page on openstreetmap.org, for fixing it there. `None` for places that
don't come from OpenStreetMap.

visits.description:
The user's visits, newest first. Lists of places carry only the latest one;
`/api/places/{place_id}` carries all of them.

added.description: Restaurants the user added that OpenStreetMap now has.

level_xp.description: XP at which the current level started and at which the next one starts.

streak.description:
Months in a row with at least one check-in, up to this one. A month without one yet
doesn't break it until the month is over.

public_key.description: The VAPID public key browsers subscribe with.

countries.description: The countries that count, for quests about particular ones; empty otherwise.

code.description: `XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`. Shown this once: the server keeps only a hash.

RefreshResult.description: What a refresh from OpenStreetMap found.

oneOf.description: The place as it is now; `null` when it is gone.

Refreshed.description: What reading a place again from OpenStreetMap changed.

code.description:
A recovery code (`XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`) or a link code (`XXXX-XXXX`). Case,
spaces and dashes don't matter.

Reward.description: XP for an added restaurant, granted once OpenStreetMap has it.

area_name.description: The city the bonus was judged in. `null` when no city around it was cached.

SeenAdditions.description: Additions the user was told about.

ShareLink.description: A public link and what to say alongside it.

image_url.description: The card image: 1200 × 630 PNG, the map with a caption.

text.description: A sentence to share with the link.

url.description: The public page, also the link preview.

Status.description:
How far the user got with a country's food in the area. Clients show `discovered` as
gold and `completed` as diamond.

SubscribeBody.description: A browser's PushSubscription (as from `subscription.toJSON()`), plus the user's area.

area.description: The area to send reminders for.

timezone.description: IANA name. Reminders go out from 10:00 in this zone.

SuggestCuisine.description: The food a restaurant with unknown food serves.

Suggestion.description: One restaurant to try and the country the globe lands on.

UnknownPlace.description: A named restaurant OpenStreetMap gives no cuisine, so it isn't on the map yet.

id.description: An OpenStreetMap place id, like the ones of other places.

at.description: When the user checked in (unix seconds).

verified.description: Checked in within walking distance of the place.

info.description: Find restaurants from around the world near you, and collect the countries you have tasted.
info.title: Mangiamundo API

delete.summary:
Deletes the account and everything in it: check-ins, added places, closed reports,
reminders, and the sessions of every device. It can't be undone.

get.summary: The account: whether it has a recovery code, and the devices signed in to it.

delete.summary: Signs a device out of the account. Signing out the current device ends this session.

429.description: `too_many_requests`: more than 10 codes in an hour

post.summary:
Makes a code that signs another device in to this account, through
`POST /api/session/restore`, within 10 minutes.

Makes a new recovery code, which restores the account on any device through
`POST /api/session/restore`. The previous code stops working.

get.summary:
The restaurants the user added, newest first, with their rewards. Those confirmed since
the user was last told have `seen: false`, for a "now on the map" message.

put.summary:
The user was told about these confirmed additions: they come back with `seen: true`.
Pending ones, and ones not listed, are left alone.

parameters.description: What someone typed. Fewer than 2 characters returns nothing.
parameters.name: q

get.summary: Cities and postal codes matching what someone typed.
The city and postal code a point (usually the device's position) lies in.

parameters.description: What someone typed so far. Fewer than 2 characters returns nothing.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Where the user is, to rank nearby areas first.
parameters.name: lat

get.summary: Suggestions while someone types a city or postal code.

How far loading an area's restaurants has come, for a progress wheel while `/api/discover`
or `/api/places` waits on it. `null` when the area isn't loading.

default.description: `bad_request` for a token that isn't valid

post.summary:
Signs in with Apple. Sent with the device's current token, an Apple ID new to the server
joins that account; one that already has an account brings this device there, and
what the device's account held moves along, as with a recovery code.

404.description: `not_found`: a wrong, used or expired code

post.summary:
Signs in with an emailed code, as `POST /api/auth/apple` does with Apple. A code works
once, for 10 minutes, and stops working after 5 wrong tries.
Emails a 6-digit sign-in code, valid for 10 minutes. A new one replaces the last.

default.description: `bad_request` for a token that isn't valid

post.summary: Signs in with Google, as `POST /api/auth/apple` does with Apple.

parameters.description: How many days ahead to look: 0 to 366, 60 when missing.
parameters.name: days

get.summary:
Celebrations coming up for countries whose food can be found in the area, with
the reminder text.
Every country and continent the game knows.

parameters.description:
The user's IANA time zone (e.g. `Asia/Tokyo`), which decides which day "today"
is for event and celebration dates. UTC when missing or unknown.
parameters.name: tz

get.summary: Countries available in the area, progress, badges, profile, events and monthly quests.
Liveness check, also telling clients which build of the server they talk to.

parameters.description: Only places serving this country's food (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Where the user is, for distances. Without it they are measured from the area's centre.
parameters.name: lat

get.summary:
Places in the area: open first, then closed, then unknown hours, alphabetical
within each group.

post.summary:
Adds a restaurant missing from the map. It shows up right away, but only for whoever
added it, and an OpenStreetMap note asks local mappers to add it there for everyone.
At most 5 a day. Once the import finds it on OpenStreetMap it earns up to `reward.xp`:
less when an earlier addition in the area claimed the same bonus, and nothing when
someone else added the same place first.

Asks OpenStreetMap for restaurants within 150 m and adds the new ones straight away,
instead of at the next daily import: for a place someone just mapped there. Pending
additions that match one are confirmed as by the import. At most 5 an hour.

parameters.description: Where the user is, for the distance. Without it the distance is 0.
parameters.name: lat

get.summary:
One place with all of the user's visits, newest first. Works for any place id, whatever
area it is in, so links such as `?place=osm-node-123` can open it directly.

put.summary: "This place has closed": hides it for the reporter now, and for everyone after more reports.

parameters.description: Where the user is, for the distance. Without it the distance is 0.
parameters.name: lat

post.summary:
Reads one place again from OpenStreetMap and applies it straight away, instead of at the
next daily import: for an edit someone just made there. A place that is gone (deleted,
closed, or no longer serving a national cuisine) is hidden from every list. At most 5 a
minute.

parameters.description: As for `/api/discover`: the check-in counts for events by its date in this zone.
parameters.name: tz

requestBody.description: Optional. Sent with `Content-Type: application/json`, or it is ignored.

post.summary:
Checks in at a place. There is at most one visit per place per day: checking in again the
same day returns that day's visit, verified if either check-in was made on the spot.

get.summary: The key for Web Push. A 404 when the server has push turned off.

post.summary:
Unsubscribes a browser. A POST, because a DELETE with a body has no defined meaning
and some proxies drop it.
Creates an anonymous account. A device asks for a token once and keeps it.

post.description:
Sent with the device's current token, that session ends, and when it belonged to
another account, that account's check-ins, added places and the rest move into the
restored account, which then replaces it. A link code works once.

404.description: `not_found`: an unknown, used or expired code

post.summary: Signs this device in to the account a recovery code or link code belongs to.

204.description: Off, or it was never on

delete.summary: Turns the public page off: its link stops working. Sharing again makes a new one.

parameters.description:
The user's IANA time zone (e.g. `Asia/Tokyo`), which decides which day "today"
is for event and celebration dates. UTC when missing or unknown.
parameters.name: tz

post.summary:
Shares the user's progress in an area: makes their public page (the first time) or
moves it to this area, and returns its link. `DELETE` turns the page off.

parameters.description: Comma-separated place ids not to suggest, such as the ones spun before.
parameters.name: exclude

parameters.description: `false` also suggests places that are closed now or have unknown hours. Defaults to `true`.
parameters.name: open

get.summary:
A random place in the area the user hasn't checked in at, open now unless `open=false`.
Countries not tasted yet and nearer places are more likely. A 404 with code
`nothing_open` or `nothing_left` when nothing qualifies.

Named restaurants in the area that OpenStreetMap gives no cuisine, nearest first, at most
30. Only where the daily import reaches (Belgium and its border towns); elsewhere the list
is empty. Leaves out the ones the user already answered for, and the ones two users said
serve nothing specific.

post.summary:
Says which country's food a restaurant from `/api/unknown-places` serves. Like adding a
place: it shows up right away for this user only, an OpenStreetMap note asks mappers to
tag its cuisine, it counts towards the 5 a day, and it earns its reward once
OpenStreetMap has that cuisine. If OpenStreetMap tags another cuisine, that wins: the
place keeps the user's visits and earns nothing.

put.summary:
Says a restaurant from `/api/unknown-places` serves no particular country's food, such
as a snack bar or a Belgian brasserie. It leaves this user's list, and everyone's once
two users said so. Nothing is sent to OpenStreetMap, which has no tag for that.

parameters.description: A visit id from a place's `visits`.
parameters.name: visit_id

204.description: Removed, or there was no such visit

delete.summary: Removes one visit. The place stays visited while the user has other visits to it.

parameters.description: A visit id from a place's `visits`.
parameters.name: visit_id

post.summary:
Shares one check-in: a public page with the place, its food and the date. The same
link each time; it goes when the check-in is removed.
